message.content:
**Overall Impression:** The interface is clean and well-structured, but suffers from minor alignment inconsistencies in the card grid and a few typography/contrast nuances that detract from the premium feel.

| Location | Issue | Severity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Card Grid (Bottom Row)** | The four model cards have inconsistent heights; "Depth Reasoner" and "Clarity Pro" are noticeably taller than "Canvas Vision" and "Sprint Mini" due to varying description lengths, breaking horizontal alignment. | P2 |
| **Stats Bar (Top)** | The first stat card ("نشط حالياً") has a distinct light-yellow background, while the other three cards are transparent/white, creating an inconsistent visual rhythm for sibling components. | P3 |
| **Model Cards - Tags** | Inconsistent tag styling: "مناسب" uses a green pill background, while "ممتاز" uses a yellow pill. While likely intentional for status, the visual weight differs significantly across siblings. | P3 |
| **Model Cards - Footer Actions** | The "View Model Details" link text is not perfectly aligned with the back arrow icon (`<-`) in all cards; specifically in the second card ("Depth Reasoner"), the vertical centering looks slightly off compared to others. | P3 |
| **Sidebar Navigation** | The active state indicator (green dot) next to "الرئيسية" is not vertically centered with the icon/text baseline; it sits slightly too high. | P3 |
| **Typography (Subheaders)** | The subtitle text under the main heading ("انقر على القسم...") has very low contrast against the white background (light grey), which may fail accessibility standards for small text. | P2 |
| **Search Bar (Main Content)** | The placeholder text inside the search bar ("ابحث في هذه المجموعة") is not perfectly vertically centered; it appears slightly offset to the top relative to the search icon. | P3 |
